depiction.primary_object: rounded rectangle frame with thick solid bottom border

readings.meaning: all-in-one computer monitor with wide chin
instant photo frame (Polaroid style, inverted colors)
lower-third video overlay or caption bar

ambiguity: It is a purely abstract UI layout glyph (dock/bottom bar/footer) that easily looks like an iMac screen without a stand, a Polaroid frame, or a half-filled battery/container at small sizes.

reasoning: This is an abstract interface-chrome toggle representing a bottom panel, dock, or footer layout rather than a recognizable real-world object.
